theme.en: AI Demand Tests the Entire Hardware Stack
theme.zh: AI需求考验整条硬件供应链

dek.en: AI infrastructure demand reaches beyond processors into HBM procurement, reused DDR4 and increasingly complex circuit boards. Equipment-policy risks and Cerebras's reported guidance increase show how supply constraints and growth expectations are spreading across the stack.
dek.zh: AI基础设施需求从处理器延伸至HBM采购、DDR4再利用和日益复杂的电路板。设备政策风险与Cerebras据报上调业绩指引，反映出供应约束和增长预期正在沿硬件链条扩散。

title.en: AI & Accelerators
title.zh: AI与加速器

title.en: PCIe 5.0 switch card connects four GPUs through one x16 slot
title.zh: PCIe 5.0交换卡通过单个x16插槽连接4块GPU

summary.en: LR-LINK's LRSV9500-4I uses Broadcom's 48-lane PEX89048 PCIe 5.0 switch to connect up to four GPUs through one x16 host slot without motherboard bifurcation, Wccftech reports. The card supports four downstream Gen5 x8 connections or two Gen5 x16 connections, widening workstation expansion options for local AI. Those downstream links share the host connection; the additional slots do not multiply upstream bandwidth.
summary.zh: 据Wccftech报道，LR-LINK的LRSV9500-4I采用Broadcom的48通道PEX89048 PCIe 5.0交换芯片，无需主板支持PCIe通道拆分，即可通过单个x16主机插槽连接最多4块GPU。该卡支持4路下行Gen5 x8或2路下行Gen5 x16连接，为本地AI工作站提供更多扩展选择。这些下行链路共享主机连接，增加插槽并不意味着上行带宽同步增加。

title.en: Foundry & Manufacturing
title.zh: 晶圆代工与制造

title.en: TSMC A14 reportedly reaches a design milestone
title.zh: 台积电A14据报达到设计里程碑

summary.en: TSMC's A14 process has reached a design milestone, HotHardware reports, placing its 1.4nm-class roadmap alongside Intel's competing 14A effort. Progress in design readiness matters to customers preparing future chip programs. The supplied item does not identify the milestone or provide yield and production data, so it does not establish manufacturing readiness.
summary.zh: 据HotHardware报道，台积电A14制程达到一项设计里程碑，其1.4nm级路线图与Intel的14A形成竞争。设计准备工作的进展关系到客户未来芯片项目的规划。所提供条目未说明里程碑的具体内容，也未给出良率或量产数据，因此尚不能据此判断制造成熟度。

title.en: Memory
title.zh: 存储

title.en: Penguin puts retired DDR4 back to work in AI servers
title.zh: Penguin将退役DDR4重新用于AI服务器

summary.en: Penguin is reusing retired DDR4 for AI-server memory expansion, EE Times reports. Hyperscalers already reclaim older DRAM, while enterprise adoption has been slower, according to the supplied excerpt. Reuse offers another route to increasing memory capacity, although the excerpt gives no capacity, bandwidth or cost measurements for Penguin's implementation.
summary.zh: 据EE Times报道，Penguin正将退役DDR4重新用于AI服务器的内存扩展。所提供片段指出，超大规模云厂商已经回收利用旧DRAM，而企业用户的采用速度较慢。再利用为增加内存容量提供了另一条路径，但片段未给出Penguin方案的容量、带宽或成本测量数据。

title.en: Big Tech's direct HBM buying draws attention to Samsung and SK hynix
title.zh: 大型科技公司直接采购HBM，三星与SK hynix受关注

summary.en: Asia Economy examines large technology companies buying HBM directly and the potential opportunity for Samsung and SK hynix. Direct procurement could give infrastructure buyers a larger role in securing memory supply for their systems. The supplied item names no purchasers, contract volumes or prices, leaving the scale of the shift unquantified.
summary.zh: 《亚洲经济》讨论了大型科技公司直接采购HBM的动向，以及三星和SK hynix可能获得的机会。直接采购可能让基础设施买家在保障系统所需存储供应方面发挥更大作用。所提供条目未列出采购方、合同数量或价格，因此尚无法量化这一变化的规模。

title.en: Equipment & Materials
title.zh: 设备与材料

title.en: AI boards push copper foil and micro-drill bits into the supply spotlight
title.zh: AI电路板将铜箔与微钻头推向供应链焦点

summary.en: AI-server board complexity is increasing demand for smooth copper foil and micro-drill bits as China expands its push into these inputs, Tom's Hardware reports. The report describes designs such as Rubin Ultra pushing toward 78 PCB layers, with denser laminates wearing drill bits out 10 times faster than normal. This shifts part of the AI supply constraint into board materials and fabrication consumables, beyond accelerator availability alone.
summary.zh: 据Tom's Hardware报道，AI服务器电路板复杂度提升，推高了对光滑铜箔和微钻头的需求，中国也在加强这些上游环节的布局。报道指出，Rubin Ultra等设计推动PCB向78层发展，更致密的层压材料使钻头磨损速度达到通常水平的10倍。这使AI供应约束的一部分延伸至板材与加工耗材，影响范围超出了加速器本身的供给。

title.en: Applied Materials India chief calls for manufacturing capabilities beyond design
title.zh: 应用材料印度负责人呼吁在芯片设计之外建设制造能力

summary.en: Applied Materials' India chief says the country must build semiconductor manufacturing capabilities beyond chip design, ET Electronics reports. The argument puts process and production expertise at the center of India's effort to broaden its semiconductor role. This is an executive's assessment; the supplied item announces no new equipment order, investment amount or factory capacity.
summary.zh: 据ET Electronics报道，应用材料印度负责人表示，印度需要在芯片设计之外建设半导体制造能力。这一观点将工艺与生产经验置于印度拓展半导体产业角色的核心位置。该条目属于企业高管的判断，未宣布新的设备订单、投资金额或工厂产能。

title.en: Policy & Geopolitics
title.zh: 政策与地缘政治

title.en: MATCH Act analysis flags risks to ASML's installed DUV tools in China
title.zh: MATCH Act分析提示ASML在华存量DUV设备风险

summary.en: Asia Times argues that the U.S. MATCH Act could leave ASML's DUV machines in China idle. The risk shifts attention toward the usable installed equipment base as well as future tool deliveries. The supplied item describes a possible outcome and gives no affected-machine count or implementation timetable; it does not document actual shutdowns.
summary.zh: 《亚洲时报》分析认为，美国MATCH Act可能导致ASML在中国的DUV设备停机。这一风险使关注点从未来设备交付进一步延伸至现有设备能否继续使用。所提供条目讨论的是潜在结果，未给出受影响设备数量或执行时间表，也未证实已经发生停机。

title.en: Earnings & Guidance
title.zh: 财报与业绩指引

title.en: Cerebras reportedly raises Q4 guidance and sees 2027 revenue tripling
title.zh: Cerebras据报上调四季度指引，管理层预计2027年营收增至3倍

summary.en: Cerebras has raised fourth-quarter guidance above market expectations, and management sees 2027 revenue tripling, BigGo Finance reports. The outlook points to stronger growth expectations for an alternative AI-compute supplier. The supplied item gives no dollar guidance or profitability figures, and the 2027 projection remains a management forecast.
summary.zh: 据BigGo Finance报道，Cerebras上调第四季度业绩指引，超过市场预期，管理层预计2027年营收将增至3倍。这一展望显示，市场主流之外的AI算力供应商也在提高增长预期。所提供条目未给出具体营收指引或盈利数字，2027年的预测仍属于管理层预期。

title.en: Challengers & New Silicon
title.zh: 新势力与新硅

title.en: Tiger Global reportedly increases its Cerebras stake 48% to $790 million
title.zh: Tiger Global据报增持Cerebras 48%，持仓价值达7.9亿美元

summary.en: Tiger Global increased its Cerebras stake by 48% to a reported value of $790 million, according to Dealroom. The position adds evidence of investor interest in AI hardware suppliers beyond the largest incumbents. A fund's holding value does not establish an equivalent amount of new financing received by Cerebras.
summary.zh: 据Dealroom报道，Tiger Global将Cerebras持仓增加48%，持仓价值达到7.9亿美元。这一配置显示，投资者对头部既有厂商之外的AI硬件供应商也保持关注。基金持仓价值并不意味着Cerebras获得了等额新增融资。

theme.en: Compute Budgets Shape Models and Edge Systems
theme.zh: 计算预算塑造模型与边缘系统

dek.en: Four AI preprints examine token merging, initialization, trajectory reuse and hierarchical processing of model weights. An embedded-system prototype and a measured magnetometry study add hardware context; this candidate pool provides no new accelerator-silicon result for the selection.
dek.zh: 4篇AI预印本考察token合并、初始化、轨迹复用和模型权重的层次化处理。另选边缘系统原型与磁测量实验提供硬件视角；本批候选中没有可纳入的新加速器芯片实测成果。

title.en: AI Models & Compute Efficiency
title.zh: AI模型与计算效率

title.en: Training-free focus maps cut encoder FLOPs in long-video segmentation
title.zh: 免训练聚焦图降低长视频分割的编码器FLOPs

summary.en: A training-free focus map preserves detailed tokens around tracked objects while merging background tokens in a frozen DINOv3 encoder inside a trained Cutie segmenter. On LVOS V2 with ViT-S, the authors report a 2.76-point J&F gain over ALGM 0.98 with 16% fewer counted encoder FLOPs, while remaining 1.0 point below the dense encoder. Motion-aware masks and a camera-compensated surprise check aim to prevent targets from being merged into the background. These are benchmark and operation-count results, not measured reductions in hardware latency or energy.
summary.zh: 该方法在已训练的Cutie分割器中，为冻结的DINOv3编码器加入免训练聚焦图，保留跟踪目标周围的细粒度token，并合并背景token。作者报告，在LVOS V2的ViT-S实验中，相较ALGM 0.98，J&F提高2.76个百分点，统计的编码器FLOPs减少16%，但仍比稠密编码器低1.0个百分点。运动感知掩码和相机运动补偿后的异常检查用于避免目标被误并入背景。这些属于基准测试与运算量统计结果，不能直接等同于硬件时延或能耗降幅。

title.en: Architecture transfer uses initialization to reshape optimization
title.zh: 架构迁移通过初始化改变优化过程

papers.authors: Vighnesh Subramaniam, Boris Katz, Brian Cheung

summary.en: This preprint aligns a target network's initial representational geometry with a randomly initialized guide of a different architecture before downstream training. The guide receives no gradients and supplies no learned features or labels; the authors report transferring benefits associated with depth into shallower networks. That could help separate training-time architectural guidance from the structure retained for inference. The supplied abstract is truncated and gives no quantified accuracy, compute or deployment-latency gains.
summary.zh: 这篇预印本在下游训练前，将目标网络的初始表征几何与另一种架构的随机初始化引导网络对齐。引导网络不接收梯度，也不提供学得特征或标签；作者报告，这种方法能将与深度相关的部分优化优势传递给较浅网络。这有助于探索将训练阶段的架构引导与推理时保留的网络结构分开设计。所提供摘要存在截断，未给出精度、计算量或部署时延改善的具体数字。

title.en: CARE-OPD targets rollout cost with selective trajectory replay
title.zh: CARE-OPD通过选择性轨迹回放降低交互采样开销

papers.authors: Haowen Hou, Gen Li, Ruilin Li, et al.

summary.en: CARE-OPD combines student-seeded teacher completions, confidence filtering and outcome-informed prefix replay to reuse long-horizon agent trajectories. It targets the need for fresh environment rollouts at every on-policy distillation update, a source of idle time and repeated collection work. The authors report outperforming online OPD and earlier replay baselines on software-engineering and deep-research tasks. The supplied abstract gives no numerical wall-clock, GPU-utilization or energy improvement, so the systems benefit remains unquantified here.
summary.zh: CARE-OPD结合以学生模型生成历史为起点的教师续写、置信度过滤，以及依据后续执行结果分配的前缀回放，复用长时程智能体轨迹。它针对同策略蒸馏每次更新都依赖新环境交互采样的问题，后者会带来等待时间和重复采集开销。作者报告，该方法在软件工程和深度研究任务中优于在线OPD与此前的回放基线。所提供摘要未给出实际训练耗时、GPU利用率或能耗改善的数字，因此此处无法量化系统收益。

title.en: Hierarchical graph metanetworks process neural weights at multiple scales
title.zh: 层次图元网络以多种粒度处理神经网络权重

papers.authors: Ioannis Kalogeropoulos, Giorgos Bouritsas, Yannis Panagakis

summary.en: Hierarchical Graph Metanetworks add pooling and unpooling that preserve permutation symmetry while moving between neuron-, layer- and block-level representations of a neural network. This addresses the cost of existing weight-processing metanetworks that operate on every neuron and weight, and the authors also extend the construction to Transformers. Coarser processing could reduce dependence on parameter-level graph operations when analyzing or adapting models. The supplied abstract ends before the evaluation results, preventing a numerical scalability or accuracy comparison.
summary.zh: 层次图元网络加入保持置换对称性的池化与反池化操作，在神经元、层和模块等不同粒度的网络表示之间切换。该方法针对现有权重处理元网络需要逐一处理神经元与权重的开销，作者还将图构建方法扩展至Transformer。较粗粒度的处理有望减少模型分析或适配对参数级图运算的依赖。所提供摘要在评估结果之前截断，因此无法给出可扩展性或精度的数值比较。

title.en: Embedded Systems & Sensing
title.zh: 嵌入式系统与传感

title.en: Magnetometry detects internal battery leakage down to about 1–3 mA
title.zh: 磁测量可检测约1至3 mA的电池内部漏电流

papers.authors: Shaurya Shukla, Chengtong Zhang, Yinan Hu, et al.

summary.en: A fixed three-axis magnetoresistive sensor and a scanning stage map pouch-cell magnetic fields, detecting internal leakage of about 1–3 mA at rest. Two mechanically indented 600 mAh cells developed a decaying magnetic field at zero applied current, while an intact cell showed a linear field response from 10 to 420 mA. The measured asymmetry between charging and discharging offers a diagnostic signal that terminal measurements can miss. The setup uses three-layer magnetic shielding and a small damaged-cell sample, leaving production-line sensitivity and throughput unresolved.
summary.zh: 研究以固定的三轴磁阻传感器和扫描位移平台绘制软包电池磁场分布，在静置状态下可检测约1至3 mA的内部漏电流。2块受到机械压痕损伤的600 mAh电池在外加电流为零时产生了随时间衰减的磁场，完好电池则在10至420 mA范围内呈线性磁场响应。充放电磁场的不对称性提供了端口测量可能遗漏的诊断信号。实验使用三层磁屏蔽，受损样本数量也较少，产线条件下的灵敏度和检测吞吐量仍待验证。

title.en: Raspberry Pi 3B prototype combines local pose monitoring with API-based tutoring
title.zh: Raspberry Pi 3B原型结合本地姿态监测与API辅导

papers.authors: Truyen T. Le, Vinh Dang Ngoc, Thai Bao Huynh

summary.en: This prototype runs MediaPipe Pose and OpenCV on a Raspberry Pi 3 Model B with 1 GB RAM, using a camera for local posture monitoring without persisting raw video. A finite-state machine tracks study activity, while a tutoring agent sends voice and text queries through an encrypted API gateway. The division illustrates how a constrained edge platform can combine local perception with externally accessed AI services. The supplied abstract is truncated and provides no measured frame rate, power consumption or end-to-end response latency.
summary.zh: 该原型在配备1 GB RAM的Raspberry Pi 3 Model B上运行MediaPipe Pose与OpenCV，通过摄像头在本地监测姿态，且不持久化保存原始视频。有限状态机负责跟踪学习活动，辅导智能体则经加密API网关提交语音和文本查询。这种分工展示了资源受限的边缘平台如何将本地感知与外部AI服务结合。所提供摘要存在截断，未给出实测帧率、功耗或端到端响应时延。
